bots.name: Homunculi Classic
bots.score: Easy test: 19 / 40. Best at yes/no questions and money; weak at numbers.
bots.desc: The character-level model, fine-tuned for chat.

bots.name: Haishool
bots.score: Easy test: 18 / 40. Geography 5/5 and everyday questions 4/5; weak at yes/no and numbers.
bots.desc: Learns facts, not language: 3,000+ things linked into one graph. Ask what something is or how two things connect.

bots.name: Homunculi A
bots.score: Easy test: 17 / 40. Best at history and animals; weak at everyday things and yes/no.
bots.desc: The 24-hour training run (tokens, rotary positions), fine-tuned for chat.

bots.name: Haishool links explorer
bots.score: Easy test: 17 / 40. Same facts as Haishool, but sometimes walks the graph instead of answering.
bots.desc: Walk the knowledge graph step by step from one thing to another.

bots.name: Haishool v5 (Atoms)
bots.score: Easy test: 16 / 40. Current English routing misses many questions; separate science scores below.
bots.desc: The new 33M-parameter model: arithmetic, elements, chemistry and physics, with visible rule checks and model errors.
